action.text: Welcome to the world of Naruto! Let us begin the adventure in the shinobi world!
Let us begin from the simplest adventure!
Congratulations on becoming level 2, and gaining a new team card slot. Let us go and recruit a new shinobi!
You can gain a new shinobi by drawing a card to strengthen your battle points. Click Recruit to obtain your own shinobi card.
Let us send shinobis into play. The more shinobis in play, the greater your battle power.
This is the shinobi team interface, click on an empty slot to set a shinobi, let's try.
Your team has become strong! Let us challenge the level boss!
Congratulations on gaining your first victory! Continue on your new adventure!
Congratulations on becoming level 5! Let us level-up the shinobis and prepare to challenge other players!
Let us level up the team first!
Choose a material card to provide experience points for high level shinobi cards, and to increase their levels! This is levelling up.
After a shinobi card has levelled up, your power increases. Let us now PK other players and test your power!
在Winning other players in 【Spar】allows you to steal their silver, and have a chance to get equipments and ninjitsus.
Each spar, after a shinobi wins, they will obtain an equipment card or ninjitsu card. Let me guide you on how to use equipment cards!
You will be more powerful after equipping yourself! Begin a new adventure!
Congratulations on becoming level 10! Let me bring you to claim your Lv.10 gift pack!
Tailed Beast Seal can quickly increase your power, let me tell you how to obtain a Tailed Beast Seal!
The seals must be stolen from other shinobis, when stealing, there may be a chance of success or failure! Go and steal Tailed Beast Seals!
Congratulations on synthesising a seal. Let us equip the seal!
You have successfully equipped your first Tailed Beast Seal, continue on with your adventure!
Continue on with our adventure!
Congratulations on reaching level 20, let me bring you to claim the Lv.20 gift pack!
Let me teach you to use ninjitsus.
Each Shinobi can equip up to 4 ninjitsus. The more ninjitsus, the greater chance of activation in battle! At the same time, the chakra level affects the effect of the ninjitsu!
Come, quickly equip more ninjitsus to try their power in battle!
Continue on with our adventure!
Congratulations on reaching level 25. Now, you need to prove your strength by going to the arena
Defeating other players in the arena gains reputation and other rewards! The higher the ranking, the greater the rewards!
This is the ranking of all players in the arena!
Reputation gained in the arena can be exchanged for various rewards!
You want to be stronger to perform better in the arena? You can try the cash charge and claim the first charge gift pack!
A first charge allows you to redeem the Five-Star Shinobi "Fourth Raikage of Kumogakure", "One-Finger Nukite", and"Hidden Shadow Snake Hands"!
Congratulations on reaching level 30, let's win more rounds!
Winning rounds will become more and more difficult! To increase the power of your shinobi, grow with me!
There is a certain rate of success for a shinobi's growth. Using more sage stones means a greater chance of success!
Congratulations on reaching level 35, fight for your country!
Each country has its corresponding officials. Officials are selected through challenges. Each official can claim a gift pack each day.
Only the strongest can be an official of a country! Come, become stronger!
Remember to join in the War each day at 19:30. Fight for your country!
Continue on with our adventure!
Congratulations on reaching level 40, come with me to claim a Lv.40 gift pack!
We have gained Super Ninja pill, it can activate shinobi's potential value.
Secret Practice has a certain chance of failure. If you spend gold to hire teachers, the effect will be better!
Try to nurture your own shinobi!
